{{Quote|Captain, Lord Vader demands an update on the pursuit.|M'Kae to Captain Lorth Needa|audio=Mkae-Vader.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''M'Kae''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between them and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], M'Kae was stationed in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. While there, he led a group that rescued the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cal Handro]] from Alliance operatives. However, he was persuaded to give away Handro's whereabouts by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for the Alliance, and the spacer pursued and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Handro. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], after overseeing various dangerous missions, M'Kae served as the [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]], as well as the hard-working [[signal officer]], of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], attached to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. He apprised [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} activities, and relayed orders from the ''Executor'' to the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]]. He also coordinated and tested [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] equipment.

In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], M'Kae was aboard the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] when the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] pursued the fugitive [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. When the ''Avenger'' lost the ''Falcon'' in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], M'Kae relayed [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader's order for an update on the pursuit to Needa. The captain decided to go to the ''Executor'' and apologize to Vader for the failure, while ordering his crew to continue searching for the ''Falcon''. The rest of Death Squadron would ultimately disperse into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in search of the ''Falcon'', along with the ''Avenger''. Before the ''Avenger'' went to hyperspace&mdash;not knowing of the ''Falcon'' still being on its conning tower&mdash;it disposed of its garbage, and the ''Falcon'' took the opportunity to float away with the garbage, effectively avoiding detection.

==Biography==
{{Quote|He's taking a last trip out to show a new pilot his route to Kashyyyk. Then, in exchange for his life, he will tell us everything about the Rebellion that he knows and we will give him a new identity.|M'Kae|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="BTM" /> M'Kae served as a [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between them and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Warrant Officer M'Kae}}</ref> Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], M'Kae was stationed in a [[Imperial Base (Rori)|home base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Brant Korra]]. However,<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Alliance!"}}</ref> he<ref name="BTM" /> largely oversaw Imperial business from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] on Rori.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided}}
[[File:MKaeSWG.png|thumb|left|M'Kae during his service on Rori]]
During his stay at Restuss, M'Kae left a [[M'Kae's journal|journal]] in the form of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] at his home base. At some prior point during his Imperial service, he hired [[Cal Handro]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was in truth a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Alliance. During his service in Restuss, he led a group that rescued Handro, who was wanted [[Death/Legends|dead]] by Alliance [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Wolff Kalos]], from a [[Rebel Safe House|Rebel-operated safe house]] outside another city on Rori named [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]]. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] whom Kalos had directed to the safe house knew M'Kae was involved, and went to Restuss to speak to the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. M'Kae was initially unwilling to give away Handro's whereabouts, although he was willing to give away the information for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Upon being bribed, M'Kae revealed to the spacer that Handro was taking a trip to show a new pilot his route to the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and subsequently, in exchange for his life, tell the Empire all he knew about the Alliance. After getting M'Kae's information, the spacer went to pursue Handro, which ultimately culminated in a skirmish [[Naboo system/Legends|above Naboo]] between the spacer and Handro's escort. The skirmish ended when the spacer successfully destroyed the [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|Warlord Heavy Cruiser]] occupied by Handro.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}

The Galactic Empire eventually began researching a technology in Restuss called a [[Star Core]], an object small enough to fit into a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], yet powerful enough to power an entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Tensions over this technology resulted in a military buildup between Imperial and Rebel forces around Restuss, forcing an evacuation of the entire city. M'Kae was pulled out of Restuss before a [[Battle of Restuss|violent battle]] over the Star Core erupted, resulting in the city's destruction.<ref name="SWG:C1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref>

Around the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], M'Kae, having overseen various dangerous missions by then,<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=M'Kae (Warrant Officer)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569518/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-492-M'Kae}}</ref> became the [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]],<ref name="ESB junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> as well as the [[signal officer]], aboard [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa's]] [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']],<ref name="CCG" /> part of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> He apprised<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader,<ref name="ESB" /> of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} activities, and relayed orders from the ''Executor'' to Captain Needa. His duties also included the coordination and testing of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] equipment.<ref name="CCG" />

Following the Battle of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], M'Kae was stationed on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] when the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was charged with pursuing the fugitive [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]&mdash;carrying Rebel fugitives [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]&mdash;through the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. While the ''Avenger'' pursued the ''Falcon'', the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at one point outmaneuvered the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]], causing it to almost collide with another pursuing Star Destroyer. The ''Avenger'' chased the ''Falcon'' into the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], where the fugitive [[Starship/Legends|ship]] evaded the Star Destroyer by taking cover in the mouth of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]] housed in one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="ESB" /> The ''Avenger'' suffered significant damage when it traveled into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] to search for the ''Falcon''.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Eventually, the ''Avenger'' spotted the ''Millennium Falcon'' after the freighter reappeared. Needa had a priority signal sent to the ''Executor'', with the message that the ''Falcon'' was about to be captured.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:MKaeAndFriends-ESBBR.png|thumb|right|250px|M'Kae relays the ''Executor''{{'s}} communications to Captain Needa.]]
M'Kae was working in the crewpits of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} command bridge when the ship pursued the fugitive ''Falcon'' into the neighboring [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]. The freighter charged the bridge,<ref name="ESB" /> setting off alarms throughout the ''Avenger''.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> M'Kae, along with Needa and the rest of the command crew, dove for cover before the ''Falcon'' veered away at the last moment, seemingly disappearing from the Star Destroyer's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Unbeknownst to Needa and his crew, the ''Millennium Falcon'' simply landed on a blind spot of the ''Avenger''{{'s}} conning tower. While the ''Falcon'' was no longer visible on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} scopes, M'Kae spoke to Needa and reported that [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader demanded an update on the pursuit of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Needa decided to personally apologize to the Dark Lord for failing to capture the freighter, and ordered a [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle]] to be prepared for his visit to the ''Executor''. Needa gave one last request for his crew to continue their search for the ''Falcon'', before traveling to the ''Executor'' to rendezvous with Vader, who ultimately executed the captain for his failure. The Star Destroyers of Death Squadron would eventually disperse into hyperspace in search of the ''Falcon'', not knowing the freighter was still hiding on the ''Avenger''{{'s}} conning tower. The ''Avenger'' prepared to go to hyperspace in the opposite direction of the rest of the fleet, emptying its garbage into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] beforehand. The ''Falcon'' took the opportunity to escape by floating alongside the garbage, evading the Imperial fleet.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided}}
{{Quote|Perhaps I can think of 10,000 reasons why I might say something.|M'Kae|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
Despite his loyalty to the Empire, M'Kae had at some point hired Cal Handro, who was in truth a Rebel spy. He was willing to rescue Handro from the Alliance, and give him a new identity in exchange for all Handro knew about the Alliance. When the spacer attempted to bribe M'Kae 5,000 credits to give away Handro's whereabouts, M'Kae considered the higher price of 10,000 credits for the information. Upon giving the requested information to the spacer, M'Kae taunted the Alliance [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] by saying the individual could do nothing to stop Handro.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}
He was hard-working as the ''Avenger''{{'s}} signal [[Officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="CCG" /> M'Kae was possessed of fair skin, as well as dark [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="ESB" /> and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

==Skills and abilities==
M'Kae had above average intelligence, slighty-above average fighting skills, diplomacy, strength, and speed. The Warrant Officer was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
During M'Kae's service in Restuss, he wore the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> During his service aboard the ''Avenger'' during the Hoth campaign, M'Kae wore a [[gray]] [[Imperial Navy crewman]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M'Kae character first appeared in the [[1980]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] based on the screenplay for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB novel" /> before appearing in the film released later the same year.<ref name="ESB" /> Although not credited in the film, he was portrayed by [[Mark Capri]].<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars Black & White: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Mark Capri as Officer M'Kae|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/196703/cid/12614769/2019-Topps-Star-Wars-Black-&-White:-The-Empire-Strikes-Back---Autographs-NNO-Mark-Capri}}</ref>

Toward the end of the film, reused footage from the ''Avenger'' scene was included during the ''Executor''{{'s}} attempt to capture the ''Millennium Falcon'' following the latter's escape from the Imperial-[[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. As such, Mark Capri and other extras portraying the ''Avenger''{{'s}} command crew are visible during that scene.<ref name="ESB" /> In [[1997]], M'Kae was first identified by name on a card for the ''[[Dagobah Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />

===Inconsistencies===
{{Quote|Sir, Lord Vader demands an update on our pursuit, sir...? Sir...?|M'Kae's line in ''Star Wars'' (1977) 42|<ref name="Marvel">[[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]]</ref>}}
In both the ''Empire Strikes Back'' novelization and the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]], the M'Kae character is featured, albeit with different lines than the ''Empire Strikes Back'' film.<ref name="ESB novel" /><ref name="Marvel" /> Additionally, the novelization describes M'Kae as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] who approached Captain Needa,<ref name="ESB novel" /> which differs from the film showing M'Kae speaking to Needa from the ''Avenger''{{'s}} crewpits.<ref name="ESB" /> [[2010]]'s ''[[The Price of Victory]]'', an expansion of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', included an ''Avenger'' card. The card has a quote attributed to M'Kae, also spelling his name as "M'kae,"<ref name="Price of Victory">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Avenger}}</ref> even though the line is said by a separate character, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Venka]], in the ''Empire Strikes Back'' film.<ref name="ESB" />

===''Star Wars Galaxies''===
{{Quote|Good day. Would you, a loyal member of the Empire, know the whereabouts of a pilot named Cal Handro?|M'Kae in an alternate scenario of the player controlling an Imperial character|<ref name="SWG:FtE" />}}
M'Kae, referred to as "M'kae," appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> M'Kae was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was eventually removed from the game with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planned for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

Rebel players who performed a quest for Wolff Kalos had to enter an Imperial safehouse to gain information on Cal Handro's whereabouts, before battling and killing the pilot. Following the player's mission to the safe house, they were required to speak to M'Kae, who had rescued Handro. The player was expected to bribe M'Kae 10,000 credits for Handro's whereabouts. Failure to do so would result in the player returning to Kalos, who would direct them to M'Kae's base to find incriminating evidence of M'Kae's dealings with Handro, and kill the base's general, Brant Korra. With the spacer in possession of M'Kae's journal, the officer then gave them the information they were looking for regarding Handro's whereabouts. This article assumes the player had successfully bribed M'Kae during their mission.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

The player also had the option of performing the mission as an Imperial character. If this was done, then Wolff Kalos and M'Kae switched roles, with Kalos being the one who saved Cal Handro, and M'Kae being the investigating officer who wanted to kill the [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] Handro, who was double-dealing with the Alliance. M'Kae directed the player to the [[Imperial Safe House]], where Kalos's forces saved Handro. The player then went to Kalos, and had to either bribe the Rebel 10,000 credits or return to M'Kae if they did not have that amount of credits. If unable to bribe Kalos, M'Kae would send the player to [[Rebel Base (Garax Hadriin)|Kalos's base]], where they would acquire information on [[Wolff Kalos's family|Kalos' family]], and blackmail him into revealing the information on Handro. Regardless of how the player got the information out of Kalos, this would initiate the battle against Handro. If the player was not initially successful, they would return to M'Kae, who revealed that Handro's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was damaged, and thus he was unable to escape, allowing the Imperial operative to return and still get him. This could be repeated until the player succeeded. Upon completing the mission, the Imperial would return to M'Kae, who would award the operative 5,000 credits and a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] inspired [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Bola carbine/Legends|Special Ops Bola]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]].<ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Empire!"}}</ref> Although the player could choose not to do the quest related to Cal Handro, this article assumes 100% game completion with a Rebel character.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
